title: The Forgotten Password
logline: Cassim gets into the treasure cave with the magic words, loads more gold than he can carry and then forgets the words; the thieves find him, and his brother Ali Baba gets him out with a handful of pebbles.
moral: Greed walks into traps that only a brother's care can open; the script states it through Ali Baba: your desire for money nearly put us both in great danger.
tone: Comic greed turning into real fear, then a tense, quiet rescue and a warm, slightly stern homecoming; a cliffhanger ending. 80s cel adventure: wide painted places, flat bright cels on twos, gold backlight.

beats.summary: Cassim knows the words going in: Open Sesame works, he enters and the rock shuts behind him.
Greed outruns strength: five full sacks and he cannot lift the biggest.
At the door, arm raised, the words are gone.
Open Wheat, Open Barley: every grain but the right one; the rock does not move.
His heart starts to pound: the treasure cave is a trap.
He gives up trying and sits among sacks he no longer looks at.
Suddenly hooves outside: the thieves are back.
The door opens from outside; the leader follows the coin trail to the stranger.
Who are you? How did you get in?
Cassim on his knees, promising never to return; the leader gives no answer.
Ali Baba, worried, follows the cart tracks.
Pebbles over the thieves' heads: the clatter sounds like guards and two men are sent away.
Wait: Cassim frozen on one foot behind a row of turned backs.
The brothers run through the trees, leaving most of the gold.
Cassim is ashamed, thanks his brother and promises to keep away from the cave.
The leader: two people know our secret now. Search the town.

sets.description: ALI-01 rockGlade strip (abGladePlate, 2400 x 1230, ground y 900; hiding tree x 520, thicket x 900, rock seam x 1820, door x 1710..1930) in a NEW colour model 'dawn': sky #6a78c8 at the top through #f0a0b0 to #ffd8a8 at the horizon, a glow where the sun will rise at x 300, pink-lit clouds, three fading stars; land in fresh greens with lilac far hills; rock model warm rose-tan with a peach rim on its left. Light and warm, never dark or monochrome.

The same strip in a NEW model 'morning': sky #58a0f0 to #cfe8ff to cream, low sun at (300, 300) with abSun, white clouds, bright greens, ochre ground, the rock in the ALI-01 afternoon tan. ALI-01 treasureCave (abCavePlate + abCaveCels + abCaveLive + abStalactites, 1600 x 1230, floor y 900): door arch x 60..280 (top y 560), gold zone x 420..760, silver x 800..1080, cloth x 1120..1480, floor dressing of coins, jewels, crystals, goblet, scimitar, carpet roll. subtitles.ar: وصل قاسم إلى الصخرة قبل الشروق، فنادى: «افتح يا سمسم!»|ودخل، ثم ملأ أكياسه بالذهب حتى عجز عن حملها.
subtitles.en: Cassim reached the rock before sunrise, called “Open Sesame!” and entered.|He filled his sacks with gold until he could barely lift them.

subtitles.ar: عندما أراد الخروج، وقف أمام الباب ونسي الكلمات السحرية. صاح: «افتح يا قمح!|افتح يا شعير!»|لكن الصخرة بقيت مغلقة، وبدأ قلبه يخفق من الخوف.
subtitles.en: When he wanted to leave, he stood by the door but forgot the magic words.|He shouted, “Open Wheat! Open Barley!”|The rock stayed shut, and his heart began beating with fear.

subtitles.ar: حاول قاسم مرة بعد أخرى، فاختلطت عليه أسماء الحبوب كلها.|جلس بجانب الأكياس يتذكر،|حتى سمع فجأة وقع خيول خارج الكهف، فعرف أن اللصوص قد عادوا.
subtitles.en: Cassim tried again and again, confusing every grain he could name.|He sat beside his sacks trying to remember,|until he suddenly heard horses outside and knew the thieves had returned.

subtitles.ar: فتح القائد الباب، ورأى الرجل الغريب وسط الكنوز.|صاح غاضبًا: «من أنت؟|وكيف دخلت؟» ارتجف قاسم، ووعد ألا يعود مرة أخرى إذا سمحوا له بالخروج.
subtitles.en: The leader opened the door and found a stranger among the treasure.|He shouted angrily, “Who are you?|How did you get in?” Cassim trembled and promised never to return if they let him leave.

subtitles.ar: كان علي بابا قد خاف على أخيه، فتبع آثار عربته.|رأى اللصوص عند المدخل، فرمى حصيات تتدحرج على الصخور،|فظنوا أن حراسًا يقتربون وأرسلوا رجلين للتحقق.
subtitles.en: Worried about his brother, Ali Baba followed the cart tracks.|He saw the thieves at the entrance and rolled pebbles down the rocks.|Thinking guards were coming, they sent two men to check.

subtitles.ar: حين انشغل اللصوص، أشار علي بابا إلى قاسم أن ينتظر حتى ابتعد الرجلان.|ثم ركضا معًا بين الأشجار، تاركين معظم أكياس الذهب وراءهما.
subtitles.en: While the thieves were distracted, Ali Baba signaled Cassim to wait until the two men moved away.|Then they ran through the trees together, leaving most of the gold behind.

subtitles.ar: عند البيت قال علي بابا: «كادت رغبتك في المال توقعنا في خطر كبير».|خجل قاسم، وشكر أخاه لأنه أنقذه،|ووعد أن يبتعد عن الكهف وأسراره.
subtitles.en: At home Ali Baba said, “Your desire for money nearly put us both in great danger.”|Cassim felt ashamed, thanked his brother for saving him,|and promised to avoid the cave and its secrets.

subtitles.ar: وقف القائد عند الصخرة يفكر في الهاربين.|قال لرجاله: «يعرف اثنان سرنا الآن. سنبحث عنهما في البلدة».
subtitles.en: The leader stood by the rock thinking of the escapees.|“Two people know our secret now. We’ll search for them in town,” he told his men.

new_assets.name: caveDoorInside
new_assets.description: The sesame door from inside the cave: arch 220 wide x 340 high (x 60..280, top y 560, floor y 900, the AB_CAVE.door numbers), three steps down into the cave. Fields: open 0..1 (two slab halves slide 110 each way into the wall), crack 0..1 (a hairline of daylight climbing the seam), light 0..1 (a daylight blade on the floor from the arch to x 650, widening with open), sky ('dawn' or 'morning' view outside), inside(ctx) callback for figures in the arch.
new_assets.implementation: Copy the door part of abRock. Slab: celShade of the arch points (townArchPts(60, 280, 560, 900, 'round')) in cave rock #5a3a3a with shade #2e1a22, a few blurred weathering strokes baked once, clipped into two halves at x 170 that translate by -/+110*open. Behind them the outside view: abGrad of the morning sky plus soft hills, clipped to the arch. Light blade: a screen-blended quad from the arch foot to (650, 1230) with alpha 0.3*light, and abGlow at the arch. Remove the painted open door from abCavePlate (fill the arch with the wall gradient) so that the live prop owns it.

new_assets.name: gladeModels dawn and morning (with screeSlope)
new_assets.description: Two new colour models for the ALI-01 rockGlade plate and its cel parts (AB_SKY, AB_LAND, AB_LEAF, AB_BARK, AB_ROCK_COL, AB_FIN entries), and a scree slope added to every model of the plate: a pile of about 14 boulders at x 2200..2400, rising from the ground at x 2200 to y 600 at the right edge, resting against the great rock's right shoulder; a front pass of the three lowest boulders hides men walking behind it.
new_assets.implementation: Add the palette rows named in sets. Boulders: abStone at r 40..90 placed by K.rng(81) in rows stepping up to the right, each celShade with the rock colours of the model, tufts and one bush between them; bake into abGladePlate (back) and a separate 'screeFront' bake (front three). Keep the bounce points as an exported list SCREE_PTS = [[2360, 600], [2330, 668], [2290, 742], [2255, 820], [2230, 896]] for rollDown. Check the dawn and morning plates as stills beside ALI-01's afternoon and dusk: same shapes, clearly different time, nothing dark.

new_assets.name: grainIcons (with confusionRing)
new_assets.description: grainIcon(ctx, kind, x, y, s, rot): flat cel pictograms about 48 px at s 1: wheat (ear of 7 chevron grains on a stalk, gold #f2c84a), barley (ear with 6 long awn lines, pale gold), rice (5 white ovals in a fan), lentil (3 orange discs), bean (one red-brown kidney), corn (yellow cob with a green husk), sesame (one cream teardrop seed 16 x 24 with a soft glow; option blur for the forgotten state). confusionRing(ctx, cx, cy, tc, {n: 6, rx: 150, ry: 60, speed}): the icons orbiting a head on a tilted ellipse, those behind the head drawn first and smaller.
new_assets.implementation: Each icon is 3 to 8 celShade or shape calls with a dark outline of its own fill. Ring: angle_i = tc * speed * 2.2 + i * 2 * PI / n, x = cx + rx cos, y = cy + ry sin, scale 0.8 + 0.2 sin; draw the half with sin < 0 before the character and the rest after. The falling rain at 40.1 is fallY per icon with stagger. In balloons the icon sits left of the text (draw after S.label at the balloon's left edge).

new_assets.name: pebbleThrow and rollDown
new_assets.description: A thrown object on a high parabola from a hand to a far point with the camera following (whip pan), then a bounce chain down a list of points with shrinking hops, spin and dust.
new_assets.implementation: Throw: for pebble i released at 81.28 + 0.1 i from abHand(P, 1): x linear from 960 to 2360 over 0.75 s, y = lerp(start, 600) - 4 * 470 * u * (1 - u). Camera x follows the middle pebble (cam on ones). rollDown(t, t0, SCREE_PTS, {hop: [70, 45, 25, 10]}): between consecutive points a hop() arc with the listed heights and 0.22 s each, rotation proportional to distance, dustBurst at each contact; loose stones start 0.1 s after the contact that knocks them, from their baked positions (redraw them live once moving).

new_assets.name: cartTracks, coinTrail and footprints
new_assets.description: Three ground trails that a character reads: cartTracks (two parallel ruts 26 apart in y, drawn as dashes 40 long with hoof-print U shapes between them every 90), coinTrail (single coins every 45..70 units along the cave floor from x 700 to x 330, y 915..935), footprints (two dotted lines of slipper prints 34 apart, from x 1720 to x 300 at y 930 and y 955). Field lit 0..1: a highlight that runs along the trail.
new_assets.implementation: One function trail(ctx, pts, kind, {reveal, lit}): bake the marks along a polyline with K.rng jitter; reveal clips by x (for the coins dropped during the drag); lit draws a 120-wide bright copy (source-atop on the baked strip, or simply redraw marks in #fff3b0) centred at lit * length, on ones.

new_assets.name: strainLift and tiptoeFreeze
new_assets.description: Two Cassim poses built from existing person fields. strainLift: deep squat (sit 0.45 without a seat, feet planted), both hands as world targets on the sack's sides, tip -0.1, eyes shut, mouth 'o', sq keyed 0.94 to 1.08, tremble on x. tiptoeFreeze: standing on the far leg, near leg lifted (ph frozen at the passing position, amp 1), arms out, tip wobbling.

owner_questions: The English speech balloons are invented short lines (OPEN SESAME!, OPEN WHEAT!, OPEN BARLEY!, WHO ARE YOU?, HOW DID YOU GET IN?, NEVER AGAIN! I PROMISE!, GUARDS?!, YOUR GREED PUT US IN DANGER!, THANK YOU, BROTHER!, TWO KNOW OUR SECRET!, SEARCH THE TOWN!); default: kept as written.
For "tried again and again" Cassim also shouts OPEN RICE? LENTILS? BEANS? and grain icons circle his head, with a tiny sesame seed drifting unnoticed; default: included.
The thieves' threat is softened: no weapons are drawn, the leader looms, shouts and lets his shadow fall over Cassim, and gives no answer to the plea; default: this version.

Ali Baba hides in the same thicket as in episode 1 and throws the pebbles over the thieves' heads onto a new scree slope to the right of the rock, so the two men walk away from him; default: this staging.
Cassim carries one sack home ("most" of the gold is left) and Ali Baba ends up with it at the cottage; default: one sack comes home.
Cassim's mule and empty cart trot home after the brothers on their own (added so that the cart is not left as a loose end at the rock); default: included.
The leader reads two lines of footprints as his clue and the last picture is the far town; the film ends on THE END rather than TO BE CONTINUED; default: footprints, far town, THE END.
Time of day is not in the script after "before sunrise": the cave scenes run from dawn to bright morning, the homecoming is in full morning and the last scene at sunset; default: this order.
The opening title card shows THE FORGOTTEN PASSWORD with the Arabic title line from script.json under it for the first 3 seconds, over the narration; default: shown.
implementation_notes: Series continuity first: copy ALI-01-ANIME/src/ab_kit.js, ab_cast.js, ab_sets.js and the reusable parts of ab_main.js (abShot dispatch, abCamClamp, abSay, abTracking, abShake), ab_s1.js (abYardPlate, abVillage, abCottage, abForest tracking), ab_s2.js (abRockRiders, AB_ARRIVE, abLeaderOnFoot, abStandCloak, abDoorFig/abDoorState, abBackRow) and ab_s3.js (abCaveUnder, abCaveWorld, abFace close-up heads, abCart rig with the mule from abS17World) into Animations/ALI-02/src/ and extend them there. Do not change any palette of an existing character. Do not edit ALI-01-ANIME.

Owner direction for this style (Library/styles/cel-anime-80s/look.md, top section) decides every doubt: wide views and pans, full sets, varied bright colour with AB_MODEL k = 0 (no tint over the cast), English balloons, readable limbs, moving holds.
Frame order: S.background(THEME.page), S.box(panel), plate, cels, light (abGlow, abBands, rims), lettering, tape transition, subtitle, S.finish last.
Character channels at tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) (12 fps); blinks and lip flaps at celStep(t, 8); camera, light, dust, glints, the heart rings and trails on ones.
Every figure and animal gets groundShadow(..., {flat: true}) in the plate's shade colour (ALI-01 review note 6), shrinking on hops and absent under lifted feet.

Moving holds everywhere (ALI-01 review note 2): idleSway on tip and head with a seed per character, breathe on sq, horses with tail, ear and head cycles on separate periods; check 13.9-14.55, 32.3-33.46, 42.3-43.9, 70.45-71.43, 90.05-90.9, 124.4-125.27 and the THE END hold for frozen frames with a frame-difference scan.

ARM_KEYS: one shared flow key list for the thrown arm (copy AB_S6_ARM, re-based to time 0) used at 4.3 (works), 17.7 (stalls), 22.24 and 24.0 (fail), and 135.54 (the leader, for the town). Same motion on purpose.

Balloons with abSay: tail on the speaker's head via abP(world, cam); size 52 (58 for the leader's shout, 60 for OPEN BARLEY!); never over a face or the slab; remove each 0.4 s after its last cue. THUMP THUMP, CLOP CLOP, CLATTER! and WAIT! are plain S.label tags (no tail).
Impact frames with S.emphasis {rect: AB_PANEL} exactly at 45.32, 60.12 and 137.74; silent.
Tape transition S.transition {rect: AB_PANEL, caption: 'BACK HOME...'} from 106.45 to 107.30 with the plate swap at its midpoint (about 106.88).

Sound (9 effects, master 0.6, all inside listed pauses): thud 13.42, blip 32.55, blip 32.95, riser 51.78 (under 0.8 s), stamp 70.62, blip 90.3, glitch 106.6, whoosh 124.65, chime 139.1; tape bed under the whole film. No effect on the impact frames or the rock grinding (those fall on words).

Cave lighting: with the door shut, rim light on Cassim comes from the gold on his right (castFinish rim '#ffd36a', light [1, -0.3]); when the door opens (52.69) a second cool rim '#bfe0ff' from the left on whoever stands in the daylight blade.
Doorway figures outside (S10 to S12) reuse abDoorState / abDoorFig so that people inside the arch are clipped to it and darken toward the gold light.
Subtitle chunks are already in chunks_ar.txt / chunks_en.txt and timing.json; the plan copies them unchanged.
Run the "alive" checklist on contact sheets (every 4th frame) of 11.6-13.9 (the lift), 40.1-41.6 (sitting down), 64.8-66.0 (kneeling), 80.3-83.4 (throw and roll) and 100.4-101.5 (the run).
warnings: The Arabic and English chunk breaks in P1 and P2 fall at different phrases (as supplied in the chunk files: Arabic P1 breaks after the call, English after "entered"; Arabic P2 chunk 1 already contains the first wrong call). Copied unchanged; the balloons are cued to the Arabic words, so OPEN WHEAT! appears while the English line still shows "forgot the magic words" for about a second.

The cave holds the first 71 seconds. It must not feel like one shot: use the pan to the gold, the pan back to the door, the tilt up the slab, the jump cuts, the pull-out, the outside cutaway and the daylight blade as distinct pictures, and keep the far zones (silver, cloth) alive with glints and swaying bolts.
The pebble throw covers 1400 world units; it only reads through the whip pan. Review 80.3-84.0 as a clip early.
S10 to S12 put up to nine figures and four animals on screen; bake the scree and dressing, and keep horses outside the camera view undrawn.
New dawn and morning models must stay clearly different from each other and from ALI-01's afternoon; none may tint the cast.
Pauses are short (0.85 to 1.2 s): every effect under 0.5 s except the riser.

Cassim's feather is used as an emotional antenna in ten places; if the merchant headwear in the Library preset has no separate feather tip, draw it in the story as a three-point ribbon on the turban (lagged), as ALI-01 did for the turban feather at 127.0.
